To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the bending strength of non-standard spur gears is improved by the collaborative design of gear parameters.

the parametric collaborative design for stronger nonstandard gear is presented; the parametric coordination rules for nonstandard gear are established; the mechanism of action of pressure angle, fillets and addendum coefficient on the bending strength of non standard gear is revealed.

the parametric coordination rules of nonstandard gears are proposed to obtain a stronger bending strength, the equation between fillet and pressure angle is derived, the mechanism of pressure angle, filleting radius and addendum on bending strength is investigated, and the coordinated figures of gear parameters are proposed to obtain the stronger bending strength of the nonstandard spur gears.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the parametric coordination and simulation study on nonstandard spur gears.
the parametric design for nonstandard spur gears and the simulation of bending stress.
the parametric design of nonstandard gears.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pressure angle, fillets radius and addendum coefficients have a significant effect on the bending strength of non standard spur gear.
the parametric coordination of nonstandard spur gers can improve the bending strength of gears.
the pressure angle and addendum coefficient are the key factors to affect the bending strength, and the fillet radius has a little influence on it.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the parametric coordination rules of nonstandard gears can be used in gear manufacturing.
it is possible to obtain a stronger gear by adjusting the gear parameters in the collaborative design.
the coordinated design of gear parameters is a useful method for improving the bending strength of gears.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it provides a new approach to the design of nonstandard spur gearing.
the coordinated figures of nonstandard spur gearing are proposed, which can be used to guide the collaborative design of nonstandard spur geared system.
the collaborative rules for nonstandard spur gears can be applied in the design process.
